title: soc2-evidence-personal-todo
content:
Quick scratchpad for SOC2 evidence items, vendor reviews, and policy TODOs

Context / notes
- Working through Q1 evidence pack for SOC2 Type II readiness. Focus on access reviews, vendor attestations, config snapshots.
- Keeping this as my daily todo; will move finalized lists to shared drive > security-and-compliance when ready.

Top priorities (this week)
1) Access reviews
   - Finish annual IAM access spreadsheet export (GCP + AWS). Mark any stale service accounts. (TODO: export by 2026-03-01)
   - Follow up with infra on 3 orphaned roles (infra slack: #infra-iam). Owner: Priya.
2) Vendor attestations
   - Send reminder to vendor-sec for ContractCloud and LogStream for updated SOC reports. Need vendor contact + expected delivery date. (JIRA-SEC-112)
   - For ContractCloud: verify encryption-in-transit k8s settings — request config snapshot.
3) Evidence collection
   - Collect config snapshot for production KMS keys (key rotation logs). Note: check KMS audit logs 2025-10..2026-02.
   - App deployment playbook (deploy-runbook-v2) needs screenshot evidence of CI gating — capture pipeline run from 2026-02-20.
4) Policies + training
   - Update Acceptable Use policy (draft) with new MFA exceptions process. Send to Evelyn for review. (target: 2026-03-05)
   - Quick all-hands slide: SOC2 basics for eng teams — 4 slides, reuse content from confluence CONFC-2345.

Notes / loose items
- Backup retention policy: confirm with infra if any buckets still on 30-day (we should standardize to 90). Action: ask Nate (infra) by EOD.
- Log retention for prod: verify LogStream retention is 365 days for security logs. If not, escalate.
- Pending vendor: LogStream renewal in April — need to confirm whether enterprise plan includes syslog ingestion audit.

Checklist (quick)
- [ ] IAM export done
- [ ] Vendor emails sent (ContractCloud, LogStream)
- [ ] KMS rotation logs collected
- [ ] CI pipeline screenshots saved to drive
- [ ] Policy draft sent to Evelyn
- [ ] Meeting with Priya on 2026-03-02 to review evidence pack

Meeting notes (2026-02-25 sync with Priya)
- Priya: focus on gaps from last auditor report (missing proof of rotation and one-time admin approvals).
- Action: add admin-approval workflow screenshots (from admin-portal).
- Priya will consolidate vendor contact list and share before 2026-03-01.

Open questions / unresolved
- Do we accept vendor self-attestations older than 12 months if they provide newer security docs? (ask legal)
- How strict are we about screenshots vs. logs for CI gating evidence? Auditor tends to prefer logs. Plan: keep both.

Random reminders (personal)
- Block 2 hours tomorrow morning for evidence stitching.
- Pull a draft of the executive summary once evidence list > 80% complete.

Quick links / refs
- Confluence: CONFC-2345 (SOC2 evidence tracker)
- JIRA: JIRA-SEC-112 (vendor attestation requests)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/policy-updates/pull/78

End of scratchpad. Will clean and move to shared_drives/security-and-compliance when ready.
